entry.summary:
[G] Raihānia Tipoki is indigenising the Wairarapa farm he grew up on. He & his wife Natasha Ratuva created a bountiful vegetable garden in the harsh soil using traditional Māori & Fijian knowledge.

WATCH Once Were Gardeners @ https://www.rnz.co.nz/video
or on YouTube here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3lS2qVBadNM-9oDfSYYI3dqfIc6GHIAG
